art_direction.description: A Gen-Z inspired, high-energy civic movement aesthetic that blends the structural clarity of Notion, the bold confidence of Spotify, and the action-oriented momentum of Nike. It relies on high-contrast Neo-Brutalist elements, large typography, vibrant kinetic motion, and undeniable optimism. This is not a boring political site; it's a dynamic digital campaign.
key_principles: Motion is Meaning: Use masked text reveals and smooth scrolling to create momentum.
High Contrast & Legibility: Deep obsidian or stark white backgrounds with electric accents.
Unapologetically Bold: Massive typography and 'in-your-face' CTAs.
Rounded & Friendly: Use pill shapes and large border radii to soften the aggressive contrast and make the movement feel approachable.

typography.heading_font: Clash Display, sans-serif (used for all H1, H2, H3, massive numbers, and editorial marquees). Must use tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
typography.body_font: Satoshi, sans-serif (used for all paragraphs, buttons, forms, and small text). Clean, geometric, and friendly.

colors.strategy: High-contrast dynamic themes. Avoid muddy mid-tones. Use Volt Yellow for primary kinetic triggers and Cobalt Blue for trustworthy secondary elements.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than standard to let the bold typography breathe.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-6 or gap-8). Break symmetry actively.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Use rounded-3xl for cards/surfaces, and rounded-full for buttons/pills to create a friendly, tactile Gen Z feel.

motion_and_interactions.libraries: framer-motion for choreography, @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth scrolling, react-fast-marquee for editorial ribbons.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked Line-by-Line Reveal. Text lines must be wrapped in overflow-hidden spans. Animate the text block from y: '100%' to y: '0%' with ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1] over 1.2s.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: Elements should float up gracefully as they enter the viewport. Initial: { opacity: 0, y: 40 }, WhileInView: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, Viewport: { once: true, margin: '-100px' }.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Buttons scale up slightly on hover (scale: 1.05) and press down (scale: 0.95). Cards lift gently (-translate-y-2) with a shadow increase.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle framer-motion useTransform hooked to useScroll for the hero image and large numbered chapters.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), massive padding (px-8 py-4), bold text. Primary button is Volt Yellow. Must have a distinct hover state.
components.cards: Solid background colors (Surface), large rounded corners (rounded-3xl), 1px subtle border. No glassmorphism on main content cards (keep it solid).
components.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for the sticky navigation and floating bottom CTAs. backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70.
components.forms: Large inputs with rounded-2xl. Focus states must have a 2px solid ring of Cobalt Blue. No native datepickers or selects; use styled custom components.
components.badges: Pill-shaped, text-xs uppercase tracking-wider. Used for campaign status (e.g., 'ACTIVE', 'VICTORY').

global.header: Sticky top, glassmorphism, logo left, links center (hidden on mobile), theme toggle + 'Join Us' button right.
global.footer: Massive typography 'THE FUTURE IS OURS' (text-[10vw]), newsletter form, clean link grids, social icons.
global.floating_cta: Fixed bottom-right 'Join Movement' pill, hidden at the very top, revealed on scroll.

home.hero: Massive masked H1 typography, dynamic community image with parallax. An editorial marquee running below the hero.
home.how_it_works: 3 vertical steps with massive numbers (1, 2, 3) aligned on the left, descriptive text on the right.
home.current_campaign: Full-width dynamic spotlight block highlighting the urgent campaign.
home.latest_news: Horizontal scroll or 3-column grid of latest updates.

about.timeline: Vertical connecting line with staggered motion reveals for historical milestones.

campaigns.grid: Dynamic card grid. Each card has an image, title, 'Status Badge', and an action CTA.

volunteer.layout: Two-column split. Left side: Bold motivational sticky text. Right side: Multi-step or clean long-form form using Shadcn.

resources.layout: Tabbed interface or categorized lists. Use Accordions for FAQs.

media_and_imagery.treatment: Images should feel raw, documentary-style, and dynamic. Wrap images in rounded-3xl containers with overflow-hidden. Use spotlight or clipped frames.

urls.description: Youth holding 'ENOUGH' sign - use for urgent action / hero.
Youth holding 'I see you, I hear you' sign - use for empathy / why it matters.
Diverse Gen Z friends smiling - use for Volunteer / Community page.
Group of youth laughing on stairs - use for Join Us CTA section.
Vibrant abstract texture - use as a blend-mode overlay or background for the marquee.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_mandate: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing. Example: data-testid='join-movement-button'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over Volt Yellow is dark (#09090B), and text over Cobalt Blue is white (#FFFFFF).
accessibility_and_testing.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion animations.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: Use .jsx and .js for all files. DO NOT USE Typescript (.tsx/.ts).
instructions_to_main_agent.tailwind_config: Extend the tailwind.config.js theme to include colors.primary, colors.secondary, fonts.heading ('Clash Display'), fonts.body ('Satoshi').
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_usage: Install and customize Shadcn components (Accordion, Form, Input, Button). Radically alter their borders to rounded-full/3xl to match the Gen Z movement aesthetic.
instructions_to_main_agent.execution_order: 1. Setup fonts & config. 2. Build layouts and routing. 3. Add Framer Motion and Lenis scroll. 4. Populate pages with images and copy. 5. Refine dark mode.
instructions_to_main_agent.strict_rules: DO NOT use complete 'transparent' background in header, overlays, or dropdowns. Ensure elements have a solid or glassmorphism background to prevent text collision.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`.
